'''Lusonia Cole''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Lusonia Cole}}

== Strength ==
[[Covarla Baldene]] obtained command in [[Dorlan]] because she was the strongest of the group that escaped [[Dumai's Wells]]. Therefore, it is likely that Lusonia's strength level is beneath {{opsl|27}}, which is Covarla's level. 

== Activities == 
Lusonia was part of [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]]'s expedition to kidnap [[Rand al'Thor]] in [[Cairhien]].

After kidnapping him and escaping capture during the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]] she flees to [[Dorlan]]. Her room there is displaced with the arrival of [[Tarna Feir]].

==Two Rivers origin==

The Wheel of Time Companion lists her, along with others, as being part of the Cole family found in [[Emond's Field]]. She is Andoran and there is a propensity of channelers in that area (including [[Cilia Cole]]), so it is possible this is true. She may have been Aes Sedai for a long time and nobody in the Two Rivers remembers a girl being sent to the White Tower. On the other hand, [[Aedwin Cole]] is also listed as being part of this family, but is from northern [[Altara]] or northern [[Murandy]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Aedwin Cole}}
